reason: I've got more work than time and my clients come from referrals, so I'm not hunting for ways to sell homes. $1,500 a home on my margins is hard to justify when I'd have to dig out plans and sit through a lunch for something I don't need right now.
objection: Is $1,500 a home worth it on our margins? My clients already come by referral and bring their own architect, so I don't see who I'm paying for.
would_change_my_mind: If it saved me real change-order money on a job and it cost closer to $500 a home, or the architect included it, I'd look at it when things slow down.
